title: Nighttime Sunwatch
text:
🌕 Nighttime Sunwatch — November 10, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.4)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C2.3 (Peaked November 10, 2026 at 07:05 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 651 km/s (Fast)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Unsettled (Kp 3.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Things are moving pretty quickly out there. ☀️🌞👀

Several active regions and sunspot groups are visibly brightening the solar disk today, while the coronagraph shows no clear large outward event.

Image: NASA SDO/AIA — 304 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
